$comment: The facet vocabulary of Stock (data, not code): every facet the storefront shows, in order, with its values, synonyms and the rules that derive auto and draft (weak) labels from the specs. scripts/build-index.ts reads it; components render any facet listed here. draft: true marks facets whose labels are weak (not reviewed by a person). Rules: a value is given when any clause of `any` matches and no clause of `not` does; There are no fallback values: an asset no rule matches has no label for the facet ("no label", never counted as a value). Labels are in en, fr, de, es, ru (ids stay English). The index builder hides a value no asset carries and a facet that does not discriminate (no labels, or the same labels on every asset); skin, radius and theme are preview settings, not facets.
